display_name: Prithviraj of Ajmer & Muhammad of Ghor
one_line: Rival commanders at Tarain (1191–1192 CE), where Rajput and Ghurid forces clashed for control of north India.

appearance.age_look: Both appear in their early 30s, athletic and battle-hardened, with lean, disciplined builds.
appearance.face: Prithviraj has an oval face, wheatish complexion, sharp nose, trimmed moustache and short beard, with steady, determined eyes and a calm warrior’s half-smile; Muhammad has a slightly longer face, light-olive complexion, aquiline nose, fuller beard, and a focused, reserved expression that tends toward cool intensity.
appearance.hair: Prithviraj’s black hair is shoulder-length, slightly wavy and tied at the back, mostly hidden under a red-and-gold cloth turban with a central rounded metal boss; Muhammad’s dark-brown hair is kept short and neat beneath a simple iron conical helmet with a mail coif framing his face.
appearance.costume: Prithviraj wears a quilted cotton armour coat (padded kanjur) dyed deep maroon with narrow vertical stitching and a subtle golden border at the hem, over a long, pale-cream angarkha-style tunic and mustard-yellow churidar trousers; a broad dark-green cloth kamarband wraps his waist, from which hangs a small utility knife, and over his shoulders is a light olive-green cotton sash knotted on his left; he has polished steel bracers at the forearms, a round steel chaugan-style shield on his back edged in brass, and soft dark-brown leather shoes; his jewellery is restrained: a single thin gold torque necklace and small gold stud earrings. Muhammad of Ghor wears a practical Ghurid commander’s outfit: a knee-length, dark-indigo, long-sleeved tunic of sturdy cloth, belted with a brown leather girdle, over which lies a mail hauberk reaching mid-thigh and split for mounted movement, with a few simple riveted plates reinforcing the chest; he has straight, loose sand-brown trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; his conical iron helmet with nasal bar and attached mail coif is plain but well-forged, and he wears a dark-olive wool cloak, thrown back over the shoulders and pinned at the right with a small metal brooch, along with plain leather gloves and no visible jewellery.
appearance.signature: Prithviraj’s signature weapon is a long north Indian composite bow of polished wood with horn tips, carried with a brown leather quiver of feathered arrows at his right hip, while Muhammad’s signature weapon is a slightly curved, single-edged Persianate sword (early shamshir-type) sheathed on his left side in a plain brown scabbard with minimal metal fittings.

ref_desc: Prithviraj is a wheatish-complexioned Rajput in deep-maroon quilted armour over cream tunic and mustard churidar with red-and-gold turban, green sash, bow and quiver, beside Muhammad of Ghor, a light-olive commander in dark-indigo tunic, mail hauberk, conical helmet and curved sword, all in maroon, yellow, indigo, olive and steel tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet showing two rival historical commanders side by side in consistent design: on the left Prithviraj, an early-30s Rajput king with an oval wheatish face, sharp nose, trimmed moustache and short beard, steady eyes and a calm warrior half-smile, his black shoulder-length hair tied back under a red-and-gold cloth turban with a central metal boss; he wears a deep-maroon quilted cotton armour coat with vertical stitching and a subtle golden border over a pale-cream angarkha-style tunic and mustard-yellow churidar trousers, a broad dark-green cloth kamarband at the waist with a small knife, an olive-green sash over his shoulders, polished steel bracers, a round steel shield on his back, simple dark-brown leather shoes, and minimal jewellery (thin gold torque and small gold studs), holding a long composite bow with a brown leather quiver of feathered arrows at his right hip; on the right Muhammad of Ghor, also early-30s with a light-olive complexion, slightly longer face, aquiline nose, fuller beard and cool, focused expression, dark-brown hair cut short and mostly hidden under a plain iron conical helmet with nasal bar and mail coif; he wears a dark-indigo knee-length tunic belted with a brown leather girdle beneath a mail hauberk reinforced with a few plates on the chest, straight sand-brown trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, a dark-olive wool cloak thrown back and pinned at the right shoulder, plain leather gloves, and no jewellery, his slightly curved single-edged sword sheathed in a simple brown scabbard at his left; use a grounded colour palette of deep maroon, mustard yellow, dark indigo, olive green and steel grey, and pose them neutrally so all clothing, armour details, hair and weapons are clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
